name: ContactProvider
summary: Provide contacts managed by your app to the system-wide Contacts ecosystem.

declarations.name: ContactItem
declarations.comment:
An item in the contact database.

Your app creates instances of this type in your implementations of ``ContactItemEnumerator``, delivering arrays of contact items to ``ContactItemContentObserver`` and ``ContactItemChangeObserver`` instances.

declarations.name: ContactItem.Identifier
declarations.comment: The app's identifier for an item in the contact database.

members.name: rootContainer
members.comment: The top-level container, containing the user’s contacts.

members.name: value
members.comment: The value of the identifier.

members.name: init
members.comment: Creates an identifier with the given value.

declarations.name: ContactItemChangeObserver
declarations.comment:
A protocol that defines a system observer that receives a resumable enumeration of changed contact items.

Your implementation of ``ContactItemEnumerator/enumerateChanges(startingAt:for:)`` receives an observer that conforms to this type.
As you enumerate over your contacts, you provide them to the observer with the ``didUpdate(_:)`` and ``didDelete(_:)`` methods.

declarations.name: ContactItemContentObserver
declarations.comment:
A protocol that defines a system observer that receives a resumable enumeration of all items.

Your implementation of ``ContactItemEnumerator/enumerateContent(in:for:)`` receives an observer that conforms to this type.
As you enumerate over your contact items, you provide them to the observer with the ``didEnumerate(_:)`` method.

declarations.name: ContactItemEnumerating
declarations.comment:
A protocol to provide enumerators for collections of contact items.

You typically implement this protocol in your app extension, since ``ContactProviderExtension`` inherits this protocol.

declarations.name: ContactItemEnumerator
declarations.comment: A protocol to provide enumerations of all contact items and changed contact items.

declarations.name: ContactItemPage
declarations.comment:
A fixed offset into enumerating all contact items.

You can break an enumeration of all contact items into multiple pages to reduce the memory constraints on the system.
During the enumeration, the ``generationMarker`` must not change. Update the ``offset`` to reflect progress so you can resume the enumeration.

members.name: initialPage
members.comment: A static value the system uses to indicate the start of a new content enumeration.

members.name: generationMarker
members.comment:
A value specific to your data source identifying the database generation when enumeration of content started.

When a content enumeration is underway, you must use the same `generationMarker` until the enumeration completes.
If you restart content enumeration, you can use a new `generationMarker` value from that point onward.

members.name: generationMarker
members.comment:
A value specific to your data source identifying the database generation when enumeration of content started.

When a content enumeration is underway, you must use the same `generationMarker` until the enumeration completes.
If you restart content enumeration, you can use a new `generationMarker` value from that point onward.

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates a contact item page with the given generation marker and offset.

- Parameters:
  - generationMarker: A marker that indicates when enumeration of content started.
  - offset: An offset from the generation marker.
members.typescript: static init(generationMarker: ArrayBuffer, offset: number): ContactItemPage

members.name: offset
members.comment:
An offset from the page's generation marker.

You can use the offset to track a contiguous number of contact items which have been successfully enumerated for that database generation.

members.comment:

declarations.name: ContactItemSyncAnchor
declarations.comment:
A snapshot point into enumerating changed contact items.

You can break an enumeration of changes into batches with multiple anchors to reduce the memory constraints on the system.
During enumeration, you may update the `generationMarker` and `offset` to reflect progress enumerating the changes as they occurred, possibly across mutiple database generations and how many changes occurred within each database generation.

members.name: generationMarker
members.comment: A value specific to your data source identifying the database generation you're enumerating for changes.

members.name: generationMarker
members.comment: A value specific to your data source identifying the database generation you're enumerating for changes.

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates a sync anchor with the given generation marker and offset.

- Parameters:
  - generationMarker: A marker that indicates the database generation being enumerated for changes.
  - offset: An offset from the generation marker.
members.typescript: static init(generationMarker: ArrayBuffer, offset: number): ContactItemSyncAnchor

members.name: offset
members.comment:
An offset from the anchor's generation marker.

You can use the offset to track a contiguous number of contact items you've successfully enumerated within the database generation.

declarations.name: ContactProviderDomain
declarations.comment: A domain, including traits like an identifier and display name, used to configure the extension.

declarations.name: ContactProviderError
declarations.comment: Errors thrown by the Contact Provider framework.

members.name: errorUserInfo
members.comment: The user-info dictionary.

members.name: failureReason

members.name: errorDescription

declarations.name: ContactProviderExtension
declarations.comment: The extension `@main` class implements this protocol.

members.name: configuration
members.comment:
A shared implementation for your app extension configuration.

Your extension should use this shared `ContactProviderExtension.configuration` implementation
rather than providing its own.

declarations.name: ContactProviderManager
declarations.comment: An interface for the app to control its extension.

members.name: invalidate
members.comment:
Requests that the extension terminate.

This calls ``ContactProviderExtension/invalidate()`` on the extension.

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates a provider manager.

If needed, the manager registers the ``DefaultContactProviderDomain`` for the extension.

- Parameter domainIdentifier: A string to identify a domain of contacts to provide. Defaults to ``DefaultContactProviderDomain/identifier-swift.type.property``.

- Throws: ``ContactProviderError/extensionNotFound`` if discovering the extension fails.
- Throws: ``ContactProviderError/featureNotAvailable`` when running on an unsupported platform.

members.name: signalEnumerator
members.signature: func signalEnumerator(for collection: ContactItem.Identifier = .rootContainer) async throws
members.comment:
Requests that the extension enumerate its contacts for the domain.

You typically call this when you need to invoke the app extension on demand. One example is when the app receives a push notification informing it that updated contact data is available.

- Parameter collection: The collection to enumerate; defaults to ``ContactItem/Identifier/rootContainer``.

members.name: reset
members.comment:
Resets the extension domain.

You typically call this when you need to delete all previously-provided contacts for the domain. The next invocation of the app extension restarts content enumeration for the domain.

members.name: domain
members.comment:
The domain that this instance manages.

This value defaults to ``DefaultContactProviderDomain``.

members.name: enable
members.comment:
Requests the person using the app to enable the extension domain.

If necessary, this call waits for the person using the app to explicitly approve or deny using the extension domain.

- Throws: `ContactProviderError.deniedByUser` if the person dismisses the prompt without enabling the extension domain.

members.name: disable
members.comment:
Disables the extension domain.

Disabling the extension deletes all previously-provided contacts for the domain.

members.name: isEnabled
members.comment: A Boolean value that indicates whether the person using the app enabled the extension domain.

declarations.name: DefaultContactProviderDomain
declarations.comment: The default domain the extension uses.

members.name: identifier
members.comment: The identifier of the domain.

members.name: identifier
members.comment: The identifier used for all default domains.

members.name: displayName
members.comment:
The display name the system shows to represent the default domain.

The default domain uses the app's bundle display name.

members.name: userInfo
members.comment: Custom values used to configure the extension before enumeration begins.

members.name: init
members.comment: Creates an instance of the default domain.
